title: Kinds of zone the player can paint on the grid (ADR-0028). The behaviour names code; mods may add kinds with an existing behaviour.

hintKey.description: One line saying what the zone asks of people

behaviour.description: What the zone does: stores goods, gathers the idle, or keeps people home after dark

layer.description: Use zones never overlap each other; areas overlap anything

single.description: At most one zone of this kind; a second marking joins the first

color.description: A view hint for the zone's fill and edge
